_about: Slalom has tight lateral turns where 8 m/s trajectories exceed the kinematic drone's centripetal accel envelope. iter-005 velocity sweep confirmed v=6 m/s passes 8/8 gates with 0.48m max tracking error.
_notes: Tight constant-altitude slalom. 8 gates alternating y=+-2 every 4m with yaw=+-0.45 rad. Stresses the racing-line optimizer's corner-cutting and the geometric tracker's lateral-G handling. Uses default planner knobs only. Iter-12 baseline: 1/8 gates, crashes after gate-1 — planner's tilt-clamped attitude loop can't track the 45-deg lateral-G demand at default 4 m/s plan speed on such tight gate cadence. Open regression target for a *lateral* climb-analog inflation (currently iter-11 only inflates vertical climbs).
